user_request: `CODE_GENERATION` , `STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION` , `TEXT_SUMMARIZATION` , and we are going to add to agents capabilities, i would like to have a research intent for agent/application and another one that we could leverage with our work in cyberalchemy v2

intent_definition.meaning: A versioned task contract describing the requested outcome, accepted input, expected output and task-specific evaluation boundary, independent of the selected provider, model or bounded agent workflow.
intent_definition.boundary: Distinct from general user intent and ARE Intent Contracts. It is neither an offering, model name, routing strategy nor application permission.

intents.name: Generate or edit code
intents.normative_definition: Produce source code satisfying the supplied specification and constraints.
intents.domain_context: Exchange inference offering and quality-routing task class
intents.input_contract: specification, language/runtime, constraints and optional existing code
intents.example: Generate an Alch service for a supplied, supported contract.
intents.evaluation_candidate: Held-out specifications with controlled compile/tests; evaluator execution must have a bounded isolated environment.
intents.boundary: Generation does not deploy or execute code. Alch support requires compiler-specific test evidence; plain code output is not that proof.
intents.implementation_status: not implemented as a distinct public intent contract
consumers: human callers through the same API

intents.name: Extract structured information
intents.normative_definition: Extract requested fields from supplied text into the specified output schema without inventing missing facts.
intents.domain_context: Exchange inference offering and quality-routing task class
intents.input_contract: source text, output schema and explicit missing-value policy
intents.example: Extract model name, supported tasks and stated limits from provider documentation.
intents.evaluation_candidate: Labeled fixtures with expected fields, absent/ambiguous cases and schema checks.
intents.boundary: Schema validity alone is not semantic correctness. Missing required evidence follows the requested missing-value policy; no silent factual completion.
intents.implementation_status: not implemented as a distinct public intent contract
consumers: human callers through the same API

intents.name: Summarize supplied material
intents.normative_definition: Condense the provided text while preserving its supported meaning and requested emphasis.
intents.domain_context: Exchange inference offering and quality-routing task class
intents.example: Summarize an ARE release report into changes and known limitations.
intents.evaluation_candidate: Reference facts and omissions plus a faithfulness/coverage rubric; no single exact wording is required.
intents.boundary: Uses supplied material; fetching documents or verifying their external truth is not part of this intent.
intents.implementation_status: not implemented as a distinct public intent contract
consumers: human callers through the same API

intents.name: Investigate a question with evidence
intents.normative_definition: Investigate a bounded question using permitted sources and return findings linked to supporting evidence, disagreements and remaining uncertainty.
intents.domain_context: Exchange callable task capability for agents and applications
intents.input_contract: question, scope, supplied sources or permitted retrieval capabilities, freshness requirements, time/cost limits
intents.output_contract: findings, claim-to-source references, source provenance, limitations and unresolved questions
intents.example: An agent investigates engine compatibility and produces a cited comparison for an application.
quality_dimensions: Handling of conflicting evidence and uncertainty
intents.evaluation_candidate: Controlled source collections with known supporting/conflicting evidence; verify references and score coverage with a declared rubric.
intents.boundary: Retrieval requires explicitly available, authorized tools. Generated citations alone are not verified evidence. External source access, asynchronous execution and budgets require separate contract decisions. Does not authorize purchases or publication.
consumers: human callers through the same API
intents.implementation_status: not implemented as a distinct public intent contract

intents.name: Turn requirements into a domain model
intents.normative_definition: Transform requirements and source context into a candidate domain model with defined concepts, relationships, constraints, source links and unresolved owner decisions.
intents.plain_language: Turn requirements into a domain model
intents.domain_context: Exchange callable task capability for agents and applications
intents.input_contract: requirements, domain context, source definitions and optional target profile
intents.output_contract: candidate definitions, entities, relationships, rules, constraints, traceability and open questions
intents.example: Describe a reservation service; receive Reservation and Booking definitions, expiry rules and unresolved decisions for later Craft/DomainSpec construction.
intents.evaluation_candidate: Reference requirements and adversarial ambiguity cases; structural checks plus independent semantic review. Compiler checks apply only to an explicitly supported generated profile.
intents.boundary: Draws on Define and Craft. Proposes domain meaning beyond extracting existing fields; produces a model rather than source code. Output is not canonical authority, an admitted Definition Pack or deployment approval. Exact DomainSpec/Alch serialization remains open.
consumers: human callers through the same API
intents.implementation_status: not implemented as a distinct public intent contract

routing_proposal.request_selection: Caller explicitly identifies intent for the initial candidate; automatic classification is a separate unselected feature.
routing_proposal.provider_declaration: Provider declares supported intent versions and limits; declaration alone does not establish quality.
routing_proposal.eligibility: Audience, current authorization, task support, readiness, limits and accepted commercial terms before ranking. Research additionally requires permitted source access and supported execution budgets.
routing_proposal.score_scope: Provider execution binding (model or workflow configuration) × intent version × task profile × evaluation version.
routing_proposal.no_silent_fallback: An explicit specialized intent cannot be converted into general chat to obtain a provider.
routing_proposal.unscored: Unknown quality is not zero or proven quality; exploration policy remains open.

agent_capability_proposal.declaration: Expose intent ID/version, input/output schemas, supported profiles, limits and execution requirements as discoverable capabilities.
agent_capability_proposal.invocation: Agents and applications request an explicit intent through the same Exchange contract; capability discovery does not grant invocation rights.
agent_capability_proposal.execution: Simple tasks may use model inference; research may compose authorized retrieval and inference. Model support alone does not establish workflow support.
agent_capability_proposal.long_running: Job status, result retrieval, cancellation semantics and time/cost accounting remain contract decisions.
agent_capability_proposal.composition: Research findings may feed domain modeling; accepted models may feed code generation. Each step retains evidence and requires its own supported contract.
